member: Kofi — Structural Enclosure and Low-Cost Fabrication Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, Farah, the box resists a strong gust without lifting where Polyurethane (PU) means rigid foam insulation.

Plain words, side wind pushes like three people leaning, while the loaded store weighs like a small car holding it down. Numbers are 540 Pa gust pressure from the wind pressure at 30 metres per second (E64) giving 2.86 kN side force from the wind force on side wall (E65) on about 5.30 square metres, against about 16.7 kN all-up weight, sane against furniture in wind.

Lena, Farah, the ground still carries everything with wide margin where Photovoltaic (PV) means solar panels.

Plain words, produce plus box spread over the patio slab press far below weak soil. Numbers are 2.51 kPa soil pressure from the soil pressure under plinth (E47) below 50 kPa capacity from the Generic Concrete Slab guide (E43), sane against one person standing per square metre.

Surya, the panel rack stays separate so the cold box carries no panel wind. Plain words, thin corners plus foam skin carry only their own wind while crates stand on the base. Numbers are 10 to 14 kg per square metre panels from the PU panel weight (E37) with steel angles from the steel angle weight (E40), as in the structure sketch (E49). Not ready, because cloudy autonomy with Surya must still close.
